let floor_divide = { lambda ; e:i32[] f:i32[]. let
    g:i32[] = div e f
    h:i32[] = sign e
    i:i32[] = sign f
    j:bool[] = ne h i

      name=_where
      jaxpr={ lambda ; o:bool[] p:i32[] g:i32[]. let
          q:i32[] = select_n o g p
        in (q,) }

  in (q,) } in
let remainder = { lambda ; r:i32[] s:i32[]. let
    t:bool[] = eq s 0:i32[]
    u:i32[] = jit[
      name=_where
      jaxpr={ lambda ; t:bool[] v:i32[] s:i32[]. let
          u:i32[] = select_n t s v
        in (u,) }
    ] t 1:i32[] s
    w:i32[] = rem r u
    x:bool[] = ne w 0:i32[]
    y:bool[] = lt w 0:i32[]
    z:bool[] = lt u 0:i32[]
    ba:bool[] = ne y z
    bb:bool[] = and ba x
    bc:i32[] = add w u
    bd:i32[] = select_n bb w bc
  in (bd,) } in

let floor_divide = { lambda ; a:i32[] b:i32[]. let
    c:i32[] = div a b
    d:i32[] = sign a
    e:i32[] = sign b
    f:bool[] = ne d e
    g:i32[] = rem a b

let remainder = { lambda ; n:i32[] o:i32[]. let
    p:bool[] = eq o 0:i32[]
    q:i32[] = jit[
      name=_where
      jaxpr={ lambda ; p:bool[] r:i32[] o:i32[]. let
          q:i32[] = select_n p o r
        in (q,) }
    ] p 1:i32[] o
    s:i32[] = rem n q
    t:bool[] = ne s 0:i32[]
    u:bool[] = lt s 0:i32[]
    v:bool[] = lt q 0:i32[]
    w:bool[] = ne u v
    x:bool[] = and w t
    y:i32[] = add s q
    z:i32[] = select_n x s y
  in (z,) } in
